thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up 1: BlueMarlin Analytics invoice BMA-2025-11 (USD 23,450) is 60 days past due. Autopay declined and their analytics cluster was suspended yesterday. We need a short plan: immediate collection attempt, payment plan, or escalate to collections. @Nora can you confirm contact on your side?

Nora Green: Ive been trying to reach their finance lead, Samir, all morning. They mentioned runway issues. Samir asked if we could split the balance over 3 payments.

Raj Patel: Paste the invoice lines and any PO if available, I'll verify payment method and bank details.

Maya Chen: Invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: BMA-2025-11
Issued: 2025-09-15
Due: 2025-10-15
Amount: $23,450.00
Status: Past due 60 days
Auto-collect: card declined 2025-11-10
Service: Dedicated cluster (suspended 2025-11-20)
```

Elena Novak: If they're asking for 3 payments, we should require at least 40% upfront then two equal installments. Offer fee waiver if signed within 24h to move quickly. No service restoration until first payment clears. :warning:

Leo Sanchez: Agree on 40/30/30. Also record that any missed installment triggers immediate escalation to collections. For arrangements >60 days, get Legal approval.

Raj Patel: If they have an existing PO we can be more flexible (net-30). Nora, any PO number?

Nora Green: No PO on file. Samir said they'd request one but couldn't confirm timing.

invoices-bot: Notice: autopay retry queued for 2025-11-30 for BMA-2025-11.

Maya Chen: Draft outreach to customer 15:30 PT below. Thoughts?

Maya Chen:
```
Subject: Payment arrangement request for invoice BMA-2025-11

Hi Samir / BlueMarlin team,

Were happy to work with you to avoid further disruption. Proposed plan: 40% due now, 30% due in 30 days, 30% due in 60 days. We will waive the 2% processing fee if you sign the agreement within 24 hours and submit the initial payment. Service will remain suspended until the first payment clears.

Please confirm whether you have a PO and the payment method to use. If we dont receive confirmation within 48 hours, we will need to escalate per contract terms.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Redwood Finance Ops
```

Raj Patel: Edit: add a one-click payment link and ask for expected deposit timestamp. Also ask sales to confirm any commercial disputes.

Nora Green: I'll send from my thread and offer a 15-min call to expedite.

Elena Novak: Keep CS looped for nudges. If they accept but miss installment #2, move to interest and collections.

Leo Sanchez: I'll draft the Legal ticket template in case we need >60-day arrangement. Maya, open Legal if they ask for >60 days.

Maya Chen: Sending email at 15:35 PT. I'll paste replies here. Tracking for audit. :clipboard:

invoices-bot: Reminder: retry attempt scheduled 2025-11-30.

Nora Green: Sent to Samir at 15:36 PT and offered a call for 15:45 PT. Will update if they accept.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If we get a signed plan, I'll record the schedule and set up dunning exceptions; otherwise escalate at 48h.

Elena Novak: Thanks, team. Keeping CS and Sales on standby. :eyes:
